notes: All 12 views inspected. High-speed power car with a long aerodynamic nose, wrap-around cab glazing, a single roof pantograph with a fairing, recessed skirted bogies, a blue window band and a green waist stripe, and a full gangway with bellows and tail lights at the rear. The underside shows skirted equipment bays and both bogies. The nose, roof and rear are all complete. The blue/green banding is generic and carries no operator marks, though the silhouette clearly evokes Japanese high-speed stock.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
Styling evokes real Japanese high-speed trains; no logos or numbers are present, but it is not a licensed depiction of any specific service.
Wheels, bogies and pantograph are fused to the body.
This is a single power car, not a complete train set.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
